 Verizon’s 2026 Holiday Deals Include Free Watches and Earbuds With Select Phones
 Kristijan Lucic | Nov 6, 2026 
 Add Android Headlines as a preferred source on Google 
 Summary
 Verizon’s 2026 holiday promotions, running from November 5 throughout the season, offer new and existing customers eligible smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Google and Motorola with no trade-in required, plus bundled smartwatches and earbuds on qualifying 36-month plans. Additional perks include waived activation and upgrade fees for Loyalty members, free internet for two months with select home plans, TV or gift-card offers, 3% cash back in Verizon Dollars and exclusive Verizon Shine giveaways and sweepstakes.
 Verizon has just announced its Holiday Deals for 2026, along with some exclusive rewards. These deals are active starting on November 5 and will be running throughout the holiday season.
 New and existing customers who decide to switch or add a line on Simplicity can get the latest Apple, Google, Motorola, and Samsung phones with no trade-in needed. On top of that, when you purchase a phone on a 36-month device payment plan, you can get a smartwatch and earbuds for free.
 Verizon is offering free watches and earbuds with some phone purchases
 You can get the iPhone 18 Pro and receive Apple Watch SE3 and AirPods 5 with the device with a new line on a $7.50/mo watch plan (for 36 months, plus taxes/fees).
 When it comes to the Galaxy S26 Ultra , you can receive a Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Buds 4 for free, with a new line on a $7.50 a month watch plan (for 36 months, plus taxes/fees).
 With the Google Pixel 11 Pro XL , you can receive a Pixel Watch 5 and Pixel Buds 2a for free, with a new line on a $7.50 a month watch plan (36 months, plus taxes/fees).
 If you’re more of a Motorola user, the Motorola Razr+ (2026) comes with a Moto Watch Ultra and Moto Buds 2 Plus with a new line on a $7.50 a month watch plan (for 36 months, plus taxes/fees).
 With Verizon Loyalty, customers will pay zero activation and upgrade fees
 On top of that, with Verizon Loyalty, customers pay zero activation and upgrade fees. That can save you up to $40 per device.
 That’s not all, though, as Verizon has some Home Internet offers as well. Customers who sign up for a select Fios, Frontier, or 5G Home internet plan can get two months of internet for free, plus either a Samsung 43-inch TV and Soundbar bundle, or $200 toward gift cards for holiday shopping.
 Verizon Loyalty members, in addition to saving on activation and upgrade fees, will also enjoy 3% cash back in Verizon Dollars and exclusive Verizon Shine rewards. That includes weekly sweepstakes for various gifts.
 Various other gifts are prepared
 You can win a ticket to a Jonas Brothers show (November 9) and hang out with Joe in New York. You can also win an NHL Winter Classic Utah aspres-ski trip (November 16), and a VIP NFC Championship experience (November 23).
 Verizon Shine will also feature themed weeks for giving, party prep, family fun, and so on through December. You can see the details below.
 No purchase is required to enter or win these, by the way. Daily drops via Verizon Shine are available only while supplies last, though, so be sure to check the My Verizon app and don’t miss out.
 Verizon also has some other perks for its consumers, including Total Wireless, Visible, Straight Talk, and Verizon Business consumers. You can read more about that here .
